qualification.status: Built from this clean Cubature main commit as Java 25 bytecode; all production Java sources match the archive and core and matching-artifact lab tests pass on Java 26. Native stationary timing and a 60 s scripted flight passed in BASELINE with four DH workers per JVM; tick accounting was independently paired.
qualification.contents: Bounded native generation, regional preparation, previews, storage and DH delivery; host-owned build pools available before biome-provider construction and preserved after adoption; save-level derived-data directory requests; optional cached cube classification and surface-band contracts; retained-column preparation and urgent held teleports; exclusive server-thread phase accounting paired with an independent lab timer and a separate first-minute startup observer. Compatibility IDs, packets, save formats and the upstream DH binary are preserved.
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously
qualification.knownExistingWarning: Destination teleports remained held during preparation: arrival was first observed 70-77 s after target-view capture start, with full client residency by 93 s. Startup ticks reached 546 ms; explicit save/purge/flush produced a 1.861 s tick. Refmap warnings and connection resets during controlled client shutdown remain. Client rendering and held maps remain unqualified.
